# p10k-rs v0.1.10 — DRAFT

> Status: **draft** — pending Sean's review. Replace this banner
> and tag when ready. The release workflow fires on
> `git push origin v0.1.10`.

**The "`daemon-health --json`" release.** Single additive
feature: structured JSON output for the diagnostic subcommand
shipped in v0.1.8.

**Test count:** 608 passing, 3 ignored (+5 over v0.1.9).
**Slice count:** 1 code commit.
**Theme:** "scripting-friendly diagnostics."

## What you'll notice (visible changes)

### `daemon-health --json`

Pass `--json` to emit a single JSON object instead of the
one-line text format. Same exit codes (0/2/3/4/5), same
outcome surface, same wire-stability contract.

| Outcome | JSON |
|---------|------|
| Healthy | `{"status":"OK","pid":<n>,"wedge":null}` |
| Wedged | `{"status":"WEDGED","pid":<n>,"wedge_age_ms":<n>}` |
| Daemon dead | `{"status":"DEAD","pid":<n>}` |
| Channel not wired | `{"status":"NOT_WIRED"}` |
| I/O error | `{"status":"ERROR","reason":"<escaped>"}` |

Designed for non-shell consumers — Python / Go / monitoring
tooling / Prometheus textfile collectors / anything that
prefers `jq .status` over shell `case` patterns:

```sh
status=$(p10k-rs daemon-health --json | jq -r .status)
case "$status" in
  OK)        ;;
  WEDGED)    echo "daemon wedged; precmd hook should respawn next prompt" ;;
  DEAD)      echo "daemon dead; respawn pending" ;;
  NOT_WIRED) echo "init zsh not sourced or env vars missing" ;;
  ERROR)     echo "I/O error reading channel state" ;;
esac
```

`reason` strings get JSON-escaping for `"`, `\\`, the C0
controls (`\n` / `\r` / `\t` short forms; other < 0x20 as
`\u00xx`). Non-ASCII UTF-8 passes through unchanged. The
encoder is hand-rolled — the binary doesn't otherwise depend
on `serde_json` and the surface is bounded (5 statuses,
2 numeric fields, 1 string).

The wire shape is part of the public contract. Existing fields
keep their names + types; future additions are additive only.

### Docs

`docs/src/reference/daemon-health.md` now documents both the
text format (unchanged) and the JSON shape side by side,
including the `jq` / `case` example above.

## Security posture (no surface changes)

- **No new dependencies.** Hand-rolled encoder avoids pulling
  `serde_json` for this single use site.
- **No `unsafe` added.**
- **No advisories.** `cargo deny check` clean (also now a
  per-PR CI gate as of v0.1.9).
- **JSON injection-safe.** The `reason` field's escape covers
  the two JSON-structural characters (`"` and `\\`) plus C0
  control sequences. Untrusted bytes can't break out of the
  string context.

## Slice ledger

One commit on top of v0.1.9. See
[`CHANGELOG.md`](../../CHANGELOG.md) for the per-version
narrative.

## Upgrading

```sh
git pull
./install.sh
```

No config-file migration. Scripts using the text-format
`daemon-health` output continue to work unchanged — `--json`
is opt-in.
